title: CartPilot Append-Only Audit Event
description: Canonical, append-only evidence record for every material CartPilot recommendation, commercial decision, customer gate, Razorpay action, payment transition, failure, and recovery step. It records explanations and bounded inputs without storing payment credentials or secrets.

actor_reference.description: Pseudonymous or internal reference only; never an email, phone number, payment credential, or secret.

model_identifier.description: Required only for AI-assisted parsing or wording events; the model is never the authority for pricing or money actions.

snapshot_reference.description: Internal reference to protected structured evidence; never a public URL containing customer or payment data.

technical_detail.description: Sanitized operational detail with no credentials, secrets, raw signatures, or unnecessary personal data.

request_context.customer_request_summary: Shopper wants a brightening routine within INR 1,500.

explanation.summary: The Brightening Starter Kit was selected by the deterministic profit policy.
explanation.customer_message: This compatible three-step routine fits your INR 1,500 budget.
explanation.merchant_detail: The selected bundle passed catalog, compatibility, inventory, budget, and margin gates and ranked above the product-only baseline on contribution profit.

failure.technical_detail: A verified test-mode payment.failed webhook was accepted; sanitized failure metadata is retained separately.
failure.customer_safe_message: The payment was not completed. Your cart is still available and you can safely try again.

explanation.summary: A verified payment failure was recorded without marking the order paid or authorizing fulfilment.
explanation.customer_message: The payment was not completed. Your cart is still available and you can safely try again.
explanation.merchant_detail: The signed webhook was new and valid, the payment moved from pending to failed, the cart was retained, and idempotency protection remains active for any retry or late authorization.

$comment: The audit store is append-only. Application state may change, but past audit events are never edited or deleted by normal business flows. The event payload records sanitized summaries, hashes, policy versions, reason codes, gates, calculations, and references to protected evidence. It must never contain Razorpay key secrets, webhook secrets, raw signatures, card data, UPI or bank credentials, direct customer identifiers, inferred wealth, or protected-attribute targeting.
